capabilities: Validate a note's workflow structure before any change
Advance the current Now block to Done and promote the first Later block
Reset the flow to restore the original queue
Define workflows with frontmatter opt-in and Now/Later/Done region markers
Expose Advance from the command palette, ribbon, and hotkeys
disambiguation: Not a task scheduler; blocks move only when the user runs the Advance command, with no automatic advancement or recurrence.
extras: README warns that long-term Markdown format stability is not yet guaranteed and advises using a dedicated test vault before relying on early releases. Further design details live in a DESIGN.md file and an external workflow article.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run small step-by-step workflows inside plain Markdown notes without external state, scheduling, or network access.
summary: Markdown-block workflow plugin that moves structured Now/Later/Done blocks through a queue inside ordinary notes via Advance and Reset commands.
